key_insight: A 5-qubit superconducting processor demonstrated end-to-end hardware training and testing for beauty-versus-charm jet classification, with no significant performance degradation attributed to hardware noise.
engineering_relevance: The study provides a practical workflow for quantum classification on limited-qubit hardware, including training-time evaluation and circuit optimization.
method: Use simulated LHCb data to classify beauty and charm jets.
Implement a variational quantum circuit on an IQM 5-qubit processor at Politecnico di Torino.
Perform both training and testing on real quantum hardware.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on simulated LHCb data found that hardware-induced quantum noise did not significantly degrade classification performance, though the abstract reports no numerical metrics.
watch_item: Quantum advantage remains unproven; scaling to higher-dimensional inputs requires larger devices and further validation.
paper_title: Beauty and charm jet identification with end-to-end training on a superconducting quantum processor
